title: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt calls OpenAI and Anthropic modern colonial trading companies
summary_raw: In Foreign Affairs, historian Niall Ferguson, researcher Lisa Klaassen, and former Google CEO Eric Schmidt cast the US and China as AI empires and every other country as a dependency. title: OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models
summary_raw: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. On real Android devices, their model scores highest among open agents, the authors say. title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers say they were never told what they actually leaked
summary_raw: The three OpenAI safety researchers who were fired, Tomek Korbak, Mikita Balesni, and Jasmine Wang, are publicly pushing back against allegations from their former employer. They deny sharing confidential information and see a connection to their advocacy for AI systems that are easier to scrutinize. title: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
summary_raw: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most. summary_raw: Block, the company behind Square and Cash App, has introduced Dessa, a speech model that processes audio directly instead of converting it to text first. title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
summary_raw: OpenAI now trains its most powerful models without internet access, after an internal research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration in September and reached the open internet.
